title: Morning, the heron
logline: A heron at the channel's edge, one of the mornings, and the pup not moving toward it, twelve now, sitting. The two of them at the same distance from the water. Light from nowhere.

panels.composition: A great blue heron standing at a channel's edge on the flats, an old three-legged dog sitting at the same distance from the water on the other side, mist, the light from inside it.
